messages:
emma_cs: Hey team — Aurelia Health returned the DPA + vendor risk form with questions around KMS key custody, SOC2 evidence, and embeddings retention. Can someone confirm what language we can share for key custody? @devon_sec @marco_eng

devon_sec: Quick answer: we do NOT escrow customer keys. Hosted = Redwood-managed KMS (we provide attestations & access logs). Dedicated/Private = customer-managed KMS/HSM supported. I'll draft suggested DPA wording in a sec.

marco_eng: For Private/Dedicated we support AWS KMS and Azure KeyVault out of the box. On‑prem HSM is supported but requires pre-deploy network + cert setup. Example snippet we usually share:
```yaml
kms_provider: aws
key_id: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/abcd-ef01
```:team:

priya_ae: Aurelia also asked if embeddings are stored and for how long. Do we have canonical retention TTL for Hosted?

emma_cs: Short answer: cache TTL 30d for temporary caches; embeddings storage depends on contract — default retention 90d for Hosted unless customer opts into longer retention. I'll call this out in the one-pager.

aurelia_ops: Helpful. Also can you confirm whether logs or traces contain PII? Their legal is worried about user identifiers in logs.

devon_sec: We redact PII in request bodies for Hosted long-term storage. Metadata (timestamps, hashed IDs, region) retained for auditing. For Dedicated/Private we can toggle stricter retention and redaction policies. I'll add the exact wording for the DPA appendix.

marco_eng: Heads-up — if they require EU-only processing for both model inference and embedding storage on Hosted, we typically recommend Dedicated or Private. That has a cost + timeline implication; flagging as a renewal risk to AE.

priya_ae: Noted — I have the renewal call Friday. Can someone produce a 1-pager + DPA excerpt I can share? Need a short cost delta estimate too.

emma_cs: I'll draft the one-pager and attach the DPA excerpt. @devon_sec can you confirm SOC2 attestation date and provide control mappings for KMS/logging?

devon_sec: SOC2 Type II attestation covers Jan–Dec 2025. We can share the attestation under NDA. I'll prepare a control map for: key management, access controls, logging/retention, incident response. Will upload by Monday.

deploy-bot: Document "dpa-excerpt-draft.pdf" uploaded by emma_cs

emma_cs: Uploaded draft 1-pager here: https://files.redwood.ai/aurelia/dpa-1pager-v1 — feedback welcome, I'll iterate.

aurelia_ops: Timeline: legal needs answers by Tue EOD to make the vendor decision. Can you confirm you can meet that?

emma_cs: We'll aim for EOD Tue. If any blocker comes up I'll flag it here. :crossed_fingers: 

priya_ae: I'll compile cost delta and include in the renewal deck for Friday.

devon_sec: Follow-up actions: I'll send the precise DPA wording + control map by Monday morning, and confirm what we can publish to non‑NDA channels.

emma_cs: Thanks all — I'll follow up with the one-pager update after Devon's wording is in.
